environment: local macOS; real React components and FOR-127 preference client with in-memory fixture transport

AT-01.evidence: 17 focused tests include mounted assignee, activity, comment mention, committed history and workspace member rendering; fallback/collision/accessibility; full-name search aliases; feature disabled behavior; directory projection and session/workspace lifecycle.

AT-02.evidence: Duplicate assignee groups and create targets retain account IDs across both formats. A chosen editor mention keeps its original ID/label attributes in the submitted command while its displayed label updates.

checks.productionBuild: passed with repository CI dummy loopback database and prerender-only auth values; protected Workflow verification passed

observations: Username and Full name update mounted assignee, activity, saved mention, editor mention, groups and member list.
Searching Alex Smith in username mode returns distinct alex_one and alex_two choices.
Selecting alex_two and changing formats preserves account-b as assignee and create-in-group target.
Missing full name, missing username and both fields absent remain readable and distinguishable.

limitations: No authenticated production or staging acceptance was run.
PostgreSQL-dependent suites were skipped without configured test databases; directory authorization assertions ran with a mocked transaction and the real session guard.
The browser fixture stubs backend/auth/file transport and does not certify a deployment or packaged Electron.
Existing independent feature gates remain authoritative; excluded Reviews demos and provider PR identities retain their source contract.
